heading: Tuesday Night
text: Partly cloudy in southern valleys; otherwise mostly cloudy. Scattered showers from the Adirondacks and Route 2 northward; chance south to Route 4; all tapering off after midnight, while mixing with snow over high terrain. Lows from the mid 30s to around 40, some lower 30s over high terrain north. Winds becoming west 10 to 15 mph, and gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Wednesday
text: Mostly cloudy far north in the morning; otherwise partly cloudy, before clouds increase in the afternoon. Chance of a rain or snow shower in the mountains, mainly northeast. Highs from the mid 40s to around 50, except low to mid 50s in southeastern valleys and in the Hudson Valley. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph east of the Greens.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance of rain from New York into southwestern Vermont late. Lows in the upper 20s to lower 30s east, low to mid 30s west. Winds diminishing to light and variable.
